title: Component stock review of the composite index: Jinwudai is definitely on the list, 99 Speed Mart is striving to climb up.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Component stock review of the composite index: Jinwudai is definitely on the list, 99 Speed Mart is striving to climb up.
A new round of index component stock review is approaching, analysts believe Jinwu Da $GAMUDA(5398.MY)$ is definitely on track to be listed, while 99 Speed Mart $99SMART(5326.MY)$ still needs to work hard, while Genting Group ( $GENTING(3182.MY)$& $GENM(4715.MY)$ ) may face the risk of being ousted.
Xingye Investment Bank research analyst stated in a report: "According to the latest market cap ranking, we expect Jinwu Da, currently ranked 20th, to be a sure bet, while 99 Speed Mart, ranked 27th, is still 2 billion ringgit market cap away from being included."
The last time Jinwu Da entered the component stocks was on September 20, 2010, replacing the privatized Tanjong at the time.
Analysts believe that if the stock price of 99 Speed Mart can rise to 2.50 ringgit, it will have the opportunity to be included in the component stocks, currently trading at around 2.30 ringgit.
云顶双雄恐出局
On the other hand, sitting at the bottom end of the constituent stocks$GENTING(3182.MY)$ and$GENM(4715.MY)$ , there is a risk of being kicked out of the list.
However, if 99 Speed Mart fails to reach 25th place, it will be added to the waiting list.
Other waiting list, also includes$AIRPORT(5014.MY)$ 、$AMBANK(1015.MY)$ 、$WPRTS(5246.MY)$ Facing the two giants of YunDing.
Due to the uncertainty caused by the U.S. election and the global macroeconomic impact, along with the geopolitical risks in the Middle East, analysts suggest focusing on defensive investment portfolios.
"We believe that investors should guard against the recent market volatility and protect their returns. In the future, they may focus on Johor-themed stocks, such as the bottom fishing strategy of small and medium-sized stocks."
The FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI index constituent stock semi-annual review results will be announced on December 5th. The review committee will be based on the market capitalization ranking as of November 25th, and will be effective starting from December 23rd.

title: Trump's tariffs 2.0 are ready to go. Reviewing the winners and losers of the Malaysian stock market (2).
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Organized report:@Jungle lee
Content: Chinese
The overall situation of the U.S. election has been determined. Trump will return as the 47th president and will be inaugurated on January 20, 2025. Analysts believe that the victory of the 'crazy' president can reduce the uncertainty brought by the election results and also benefit areas such as Malaysian plantation, gloves, technology, and transportation. Lianchang International Investment Bank analysts pointed out that with Trump's victory, the period from November to December will enter a new presidential transition phase. At that time, Trump can use this time to form a cabinet, streamline personnel and institutions, and launch a series of policy directions next year. Current policies that may have a certain impact on Malaysia include the Trump administration's plans to impose tariffs of 10% to 20% on imports, with tariffs from China possibly as high as 60%; furthermore, there may be involvement in ending the Russia-Ukraine war. Analysts say the U.S. dollar index may appreciate by 2% to 3%, while the 10-year U.S. Treasury bond yield may drop by 20 basis points. In addition, the Federal Reserve's upcoming dot plot of interest rates may change. However, given the continued decline in inflation and falling energy prices, Federal Reserve's Powell is likely to continue maintaining a dovish stance. Most importantly, after the US election, any uncertainties are beginning to dissipate, and it is expected that funds will start flowing into the market. This is bullish news for the Malaysian stock market, as the composite index was affected by arbitrage wait-and-see sentiment before the election and has been in a retracement state. 分析员也借此分析了特朗普政府的政策，会对大马产生的潜在影响。 潜在赢家： ■种植板块 -如果中国对美国大豆加征关税，届时中国商家会转向其他食用油，从而提振对棕油需求。 -如果特朗普成功促成俄乌停战，届时地缘政治风险降低，或有利于食用油贸易。 -推荐公司包括SD牙直利 $SDG (5285.MY)$ 、IOI集团 $IOICORP (1961.MY)$ Synthetic planting $HSPLANT (5138.MY)$ and Daan $TAANN (5012.MY)$ 。 ■ Glove Sector - The strengthening of the US dollar is beneficial to Malaysian glove manufacturers. If the US imposes tariffs on Chinese gloves, the demand for Malaysian gloves may increase. - Recommended companies include Hartalega $HARTA (5168.MY)$ and Top Glove $TOPGLOV (7113.MY)$ 。 ■Technology Sector - Malaysia's technology sector may accelerate supply chain expansion, benefiting equipment and automation equipment providers such as Vitrox Corporation and Pentamaster $VITROX (0097.MY)$ and JCY $GENETEC (0104.MY)$ are advantageous. - The 60% tariff on Chinese imported goods may prompt the supply chain to shift from North Asia, benefiting Malaysia and Vietnam, advantageous for Malaysia's electrical components services (EMS), semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT), and automated test equipment (ATE) suppliers. - The strengthening of the US dollar against the Ringgit is also beneficial for the related sectors, but China's retaliatory measures may pose challenges. ■Transportation Sector - Imposing higher tariffs on Chinese goods may accelerate trade diversification, benefiting Westports Holdings $WPRTS (5246.MY)$ Under the China Plus One strategy, it attracts foreign direct investment (FDI) and drives Malaysia's export and FDI trends. - Recommended companies include Westports Holdings. ■ Gambling Sector - If the Singapore dollar and the US dollar strengthen, Genting Sing may benefit, especially since Genting Singapore accounts for 99% of the group's core net income in 2023. $GENTING (3182.MY)$ - However, the impact on Genting Malaysia is limited, as the profit from Resorts World New York casino may be offset by losses from Empire Resorts. - Recommended companies include Genting Malaysia. $GENM (4715.MY)$ - The impact on Genting Malaysia is limited because the profits from Resorts World New York casino may be offset by losses from Empire Resorts. - Recommended companies include Genting Malaysia. ■ Public Utilities Sector - Trump's policies on national energy bring neutral effects $TENAGA (5347.MY)$ but if the new selling price and the USD strengthen, it may be beneficial for Yang Zhongli Power $YTLPOWR (6742.MY)$ due to the outstanding performance of its Singapore subsidiaries. - Recommended companies are national energy and Yang Zhongli Power. ■ Medical Care Sector - If the new selling price and the USD strengthen, it is expected to have a positive impact on the IIHH Medical Group $IHH (5225.MY)$ mainly due to the increased proportion of its business in Singapore. IHH Medical Group is recommended as the company. ############ Potential losers ■ Automobile Sector - The possible strength of the USD against the Malaysian Ringgit may increase import costs, which could lower the profitability of the automotive industry. - Domestic tightening of monetary policy due to inflationary pressures may lead to higher interest rates, thereby affecting consumers' ability to bear the expense of purchasing cars in the automotive market. - If the United States imposes a 60% tariff on Chinese imported goods, the Chinese economy may be suppressed, leading to reduced consumer spending, which could impact Sinarmas' business in the automotive sector in China. $SIME (4197.MY)$ - If the United States imposes a 60% tariff on Chinese imported goods, the Chinese economy may be suppressed, leading to reduced consumer spending, which could impact Sinarmas' business in the automotive sector in China. -Oil & gas sector -Trump's energy policy generally supports the expansion of domestic oil production in the United States, planning to increase exploration permits and relax environmental regulations to boost output. -Trump plans to cut some key provisions in the "Inflation Reduction Act" (such as clean energy tax incentives), which will reduce the U.S. participation in global climate initiatives. -Global oil prices may remain stable, with Brent crude forecasted to be between $73 and $75 per barrel next year. -Global production growth, along with reduced Chinese demand and no major geopolitical conflicts, are expected to keep oil prices within this range. ############## Neutral -Banks sector -“中国+1”战略若带来更多外商投资，可能推动贷款增长，但美国因关税提升带来的通胀压力或推迟降息，大幅影响利率下修的可能性，从而影响债券交易和投资收益。 -尽管中国经济存在不确定性，分析员对丰隆银行 $HLBANK (5819.MY)$ 的前景仍持积极看法，认为其中国合资企业的潜在放缓，已反映在股价里。 -推荐公司，包括丰隆银行、大马银行 $AMBANK (1015.MY)$ 和马银行 $MAYBANK (1155.MY)$ 。 ■电信板块 -美元走强可能导致亚通 $AXIATA (6888.MY)$ Incurred foreign exchange losses, as its debts are denominated in US dollars. Recommended companies include Tianditong Digital Network $CDB (6947.MY)$ and Mingxun $MAXIS (6012.MY)$ 。 ■ Consumer Sector - The strong US dollar may increase export income, but the additional costs of imported goods and raw materials may offset this positive development. - Recommended companies include Farm Fresh $FFB (5306.MY)$ and Mr.DIY $MRDIY (5296.MY)$ And aeon stores $AEON (6599.MY)$ 。 ■ Production trust sector - The United States imposing a 60% tariff on Chinese goods may weaken the Chinese economy, reduce the number of Chinese tourists, and adversely affect retail and hotel sectors. - The recommended company for Genting sing production trust $SUNREIT (5176.MY)$ 。 ■ Industrial sector - Overall, the impact on the industrial sector is neutral, but the tariff increase on gloves manufactured in China may affect Top Glove $MAHSING (8583.MY)$ The glove manufacturing business is advantageous. ■ Building material sector - If there is a full-scale trade war between China and the United States, the Malaysian building materials industry may be affected, but it is expected that after Trump's reelection, the likelihood of imposing more tariffs on Chinese steel is low. - Key risks include new tariffs covering non-Chinese markets, blocking evasion measures, and the continuous strengthening of the US dollar, which may suppress basic metals in the global recovery.
Developers entering the industrial sector will benefit Analysts also predict that the ASEAN region will be in a favorable position, and Malaysian developers with strategic layouts in the industrial sector will see new opportunities. Industrial Bank research analysts believe that with the dust settled on the US presidential election, the expectation is that the tense trade situation between the US and China will continue, or even escalate further. The report points out that the ASEAN region, as a key location for global trade, is expected to attract more foreign direct investment (FDI), which will benefit local developers involved in the industrial sector. “回看之前‘特朗普1.0’时期，即2017至2021年，我们观察到大量制造业活动从东亚和欧洲国家，扩张或迁移至该区域。” 分析员称，当时部分大马工业园开发商，像是位于柔佛的i-Park和努沙再也科技园，经历了工业地块和工厂需求的急剧增加。 鉴于此，分析员预计未来几年内，美国可能实施的潜在关税将影响某些行业，但整体来看，跨国公司仍将东盟视为亚洲扩张计划的理想投资地。 数据中心投资照旧 “我们认为，大马的数据中心投资亦不会受到影响。从基本面来看，凭借我国中立政治立场，依然是数据中心的理想选址。” 因此，分析员认为，参与数据中心投资的公司，如森那美产业 $SIMEPROP (5288.MY)$ 和马星集团，未来仍有望吸引更多需求。 纵观这个行业，分析员认为，需求稳定的住宅市场、大型基建开发以及投资资金的流入，将继续推动行业发展。 The upcoming details of the Johor-Singapore Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the potential Johor Bahru-Singapore High-Speed Rail (HSR) project are expected to further attract investors' interest, therefore, analysts are more inclined towards developers with industrial developments. Analysts maintain a 'shareholding' rating, with preferred stocks including Sunway Industry, Mah Sing Group, and Top Glove. $SUNWAY (5211.MY)$ and UEM Sunrise $UEMS (5148.MY)$ 。
Trump's victory inspires a stronger US dollar. Ringgit falls below 4.42 to a new low in nearly 3 months
With the release of the results of the US presidential election, the strong performance of the US dollar exchange rates inspires a significant rise, causing the Ringgit to devalue for two consecutive days, dropping to 4.4265 at one point, hitting nearly a 3-month low. On early Thursday, the Ringgit exchange rate opened with a gap down, dropping to 4.4265 against 1 US dollar at one point, approaching the lowest level since August 16th. In fact, since yesterday afternoon, when Trump's votes were significantly ahead, the Ringgit against the US dollar has shown a bearish trend, plummeting and breaking below the 4.40 level. With the continuous decline over the past two days, the Ringgit exchange rate has accumulated a 1.5% decline. On the other hand, most major Asian currencies against the US dollar were also trending downwards on Thursday, with the Thai Baht experiencing the heaviest decline at 0.73%, while the Taiwanese Dollar, the Chinese Renminbi, and the Philippine Peso had milder declines. The Fed's rate cuts are slower. Fenglong Investment Bank's research analysis believes that Trump's policies will bring inflationary risks, which may slow down the Fed's rate cut cycle more than previously expected. Looking back, the Fed cut rates for the first time in many years by 50 basis points in September, with expectations of another 50 basis points cut by the end of the season, and a further 100 basis points cut in 2025. However, with the market's increasing expectations for a milder rate cut cycle by the Fed, the narrowing trend in interest rate differentials between Malaysia and the US is slowing down, which is unfavorable to the Ringgit exchange rate. Therefore, analysts have adjusted their year-end and full-year average forecasts for the Ringgit against the US dollar to 4.50 and 4.58 respectively, compared to the previous expectations of 4.05 and 4.50. Despite this, we still expect the Ringgit exchange rates to appreciate next year, with year-end and full-year average targets of 4.00 and 4.34.
Investing huge sums to support Trump. Is Musk reaping rewards or courting disaster?
$Tesla (TSLA.US)$ In order to help Trump win the US presidential election, no billionaire has done more than Musk. According to Bloomberg, the owner of Tesla and SpaceX will soon find out if his actions will bring rewards or lead to disaster. The continually expanding political connections have already demonstrated Musk's courage, but this time he is gaining not just a White House ally. Trump has promised to give him an official role responsible for cutting government spending, which will also give Musk the power to influence policies and regulate his vast corporate empire through federal agencies. "He is very individualistic, unique, a super genius," Trump said on the eve when speaking to supporters about Musk. "We must protect our geniuses. We don't have many like him." Regardless, Tesla's stock price has been soaring. Due to investors hoping to profit from the opportunity of Trump returning to the White House, the stock surged 15% during the US session. Musk also posted a chart on Wednesday morning, claiming that the usage of his social network X set a historical record. "Enjoy it," he wrote in another post, attaching a satirical photo of himself carrying a water tank into an oval office, which was a tribute to when he took over Twitter by carrying a water tank into the Twitter headquarters. Most aggressive agent In the past few months, Musk has been Trump's most aggressive agent. The world's richest person rallied for Trump on X, hosted a town hall meeting in the key battleground state of Pennsylvania, and appeared at Trump's Madison Square Garden rally, overshadowing even Trump's running partner, JD Vance. To support Trump and the Republicans fiercely contesting seats in Congress, Musk contributed over 0.13 billion USD (about 0.57 billion MYR), making him one of the top donors in this election cycle. On election day, Musk flew on a private jet from Texas to Florida after voting, watching the election results at Mar-a-Lago with Trump and his family. Musk's political action committee released a photo of him sitting alongside Trump and UFC President Dana White. "Elon Musk may be new to politics, but as a billionaire and tech tycoon, his full support for President Trump is significant," said Joe Devid Longo, leader of "Early Voting Action" in Pennsylvania dedicated to registering Republican voters. Trump's victory in Pennsylvania was crucial for his overall success. He won Pennsylvania in 2016 during his first presidential campaign, but lost in the state in the 2020 election. Musk donated $1 million USD (approximately 4.4 million Malaysian Ringgit) to the "Early Voting Action". The business empire reaps benefits. Musk could gain significant economic benefits from the incoming Trump administration. He oversees a business empire consisting of six companies, several of which have close ties to the US federal government. SpaceX has become an increasingly important partner of NASA and the US Department of Defense, with contracts worth billions of dollars. Tesla is banking on developing self-driving taxis for its financial future, a high-risk business facing significant regulatory hurdles. According to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, Musk's personal wealth fluctuated significantly during Biden's presidency, reaching as high as $340 billion USD (approximately 1.5 trillion Malaysian Ringgit) and as low as $124 billion USD (approximately 545.6 billion Malaysian Ringgit). However, Musk's personal wealth overall continues to trend upward. As of election day, his net worth was $263.8 billion USD (approximately 1.16 trillion Malaysian Ringgit).
Xi Jinping officially congratulates Trump on his election.
Looking forward to a new way for China and the USA to get along in the correct way.
Chinese President Xi Jinping phoned to congratulate the Republican candidate Trump on his election as the President of the United States, and expressed hopes that the two countries will strengthen dialogue and communication, and discover a new way for China and the USA to interact correctly in a new era.
According to Xinhua News Agency, Xi Jinping telephoned Trump on Thursday to congratulate him on his election as President of the United States.
Xi Jinping said, "History shows us that cooperation between China and the USA benefits both, while confrontation harms both. A stable, healthy, and sustainable Sino-US relationship is in the common interests of both countries and meets the expectations of the international community."
He stated that he hopes both sides uphold the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, cooperation, and mutual benefit, strengthen dialogue and communication, properly manage differences, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, find a new way for China and the USA to interact correctly in a new era, benefit both countries, and contribute to the world.
Chinese Vice President Han Zheng also called Pence on the same day to congratulate him on being elected Vice President of the United States.
CNN reported that Trump had praised Xi Jinping as a "very good friend" during his tenure, but their relationship apparently needs repair. This is because after the coronavirus outbreak, Trump directly pointed at China as the origin of the virus, and even referred to the coronavirus as the "China virus".
During this election campaign, Trump has repeatedly threatened to impose heavy taxes of 100% to 200% on imported goods from China. When questioned during an interview with The Wall Street Journal last month about whether the US would send troops to Taiwan in case of Chinese aggression, Trump refused to give a direct answer and said, "He (Xi Jinping) respects me, and also knows that I am very crazy."

title: Malaysia Morning Wrap | Tenaga Nasional Bhd 3Q Profit Up 85% on RM1.12 Billion Forex Gain
author: Moomoo News MY
body:
Good morning mooers! Here are things you need to know about today's market:
● Us Market Was Closed Overnight (and Closes Early on Friday) in Observance of the Thanksgiving Holiday
● Penang Considers Special Financial Zone to Boost Economy and Job Opportunities
● Asian Emerging Market Bonds' Valuation Shifts Amid Trump's Tariff Policies
● Stocks to Watch: TENAGA, CIMB, HLFG, etc.
- Moomoo News MY
Wall Street Summary
US market was closed overnight (and closes early on Friday) in observance of the Thanksgiving holiday.
Breaking News
Penang Considers Special Financial Zone to Boost Economy and Job Opportunities
The Chief Minister of Penang, Chow Kon Yeow, has announced that the Penang Institute (PI) is currently studying the feasibility of establishing a Special Financial Zone (SFZ) in Penang to stimulate economic growth. A round-table session with industry experts in finance, banking, insurance, fintech, and wealth management was held to discuss the proposal, and the framework for the SFZ will be presented to the State Executive Council once the PI study is complete. A public workshop on September 24th saw over 100 participants from logistics, trade, and financial sectors, with 93% in favor of the SFZ due to its potential to create jobs for young graduates and increase capital financing for the local advanced manufacturing sector. Gurney Bay and Andaman Island were identified as the primary locations for the SFZ. Concerns raised included traffic congestion, talent shortage, and low salary offers. These discussions took place during the Supply and Development Budget Bill 2025 at the State Legislative Assembly, which was subsequently approved after debates by 40 state assemblymen.
Asian Emerging Market Bonds' Valuation Shifts Amid Trump's Tariff Policies
Asian emerging market bonds are becoming pricier, reducing their appeal relative to global peers amid potential easing of Trump's tariff policies. Yield spreads for South Korea, the Philippines, India, China, Malaysia, and Indonesia are trading below their 12-month average, indicating higher valuations compared to markets like Colombia and Mexico. A milder trade outcome and lower Treasury yields could boost EM currencies, making cheaper bonds more attractive to foreign investors. Goldman Sachs suggests that Latin American markets may outperform if trade policies are more benign. South Korea's 10-year yield is notably lower than US Treasuries, while Mexico and Colombia show higher valuations. Market reactions to Trump's tariff threats suggest a negotiable starting position, with potential for EM asset flows to rebound if risks don't materialize.
Stocks to Watch
$TENAGA (5347.MY)$ reported an 85% increase in net profit to RM1.58 billion in the third quarter of 2024, compared to RM856.2 million in the same period last year. This significant growth was largely due to substantial foreign exchange gains, with a forex gain of RM1.12 billion, as opposed to a net gain of only RM4.6 million in the third quarter of 2023. The company's quarterly revenue also saw a 6.6% increase to RM14.35 billion, driven by an increase in electricity sales.
$CIMB (1023.MY)$ , Malaysia's second-largest bank by assets, experienced a nearly 10% rise in net profit for the third quarter of 2024, reaching RM2.03 billion from RM1.85 billion a year earlier. This growth was attributed to a healthy increase in both net interest income and non-interest income. Net interest income increased by 1.8% year-on-year, while net fees and commission income grew by 9.2%, and other non-interest income surged by 28%. Revenue for the quarter grew to RM5.74 billion, up from RM5.3 billion.
$HLFG (1082.MY)$ saw its net profit rise by 14% year-on-year to RM847.67 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024, from RM741.65 million a year earlier. This increase was driven by the banking and insurance businesses. Quarterly revenue also rose to RM1.89 billion from RM1.58 billion a year ago. Hong Leong Bank Bhd's net profit for the first quarter of 2025 increased by 5.8% to RM1.09 billion from RM1.03 billion last year, due to a rise in both net interest income and non-interest income. Revenue grew to RM1.6 billion, up from RM1.39 billion.
$AXIATA (6888.MY)$ , the country's largest telecommunications company by revenue, returned to profitability with a net profit of RM976.67 million in the third quarter of 2024, compared to a net loss of RM797.41 million a year ago. This turnaround was due to currency gains and other one-off items that offset a decline in operating income. The company recorded forex gains on financing totaling RM1.03 billion and another RM306.10 million from the early redemption of debt. Revenue was RM5.32 billion, a 5.3% decline compared to RM5.62 billion, which the company attributed to the depreciation of the Indonesian rupiah and Bangladeshi taka against the ringgit.
$IHH (5225.MY)$ 's net profit for the third quarter of 2024 remained flat at RM534 million, compared with RM532 million in the third quarter of 2023. Quarterly revenue decreased by 3% to RM5.6 billion from RM5.8 billion the previous year. The company, which operates in Turkey, had to adjust its financial statements to account for the decreasing purchasing power of the Turkish lira due to high inflation by applying a specific accounting standard (MFRS 129). This resulted in IHH's net profit for the corresponding quarter in 2023 being inflated by RM224 million.
$SIME (4197.MY)$ 's net profit for the first quarter of 2025 jumped by 36% to RM800 million from RM589 million a year ago, primarily due to profit contributions from the UMW division and gain on the disposal of Malaysia Vision Valley land. Quarterly revenue increased by 31% to RM18.26 billion from RM13.98 billion.
$GENTING (3182.MY)$ 's net profit for the third quarter of 2024 fell by 57% year-on-year to RM223.8 million from RM520.52 million, due to higher property, plant, and equipment write-offs totaling RM207.3 million, compared to RM1.3 million the previous year. Quarterly revenue decreased by 11.2% to RM6.54 billion from RM7.37 billion, due to declining contributions from its leisure and hospitality division. This was the lowest quarterly revenue since the first quarter of 2023, when it recorded revenue of RM5.82 billion.
$GENM (4715.MY)$, a 49.3% subsidiary of Genting Bhd, reported a net profit of RM569.16 million, marking a near six-year high and a more than threefold increase from RM177.41 million. This was due to recognizing net unrealized forex gains of RM601.8 million on its US-dollar denominated borrowings, compared to a forex loss of RM1.7 million previously. Revenue increased by a marginal 1.45% to RM2.75 billion from RM2.7 billion, due to higher revenue from its leisure and hospitality businesses in the UK and Egypt.
$PBBANK (1295.MY)$ 's net profit for the third quarter of 2024 fell by 44.1% to RM208.12 million from RM372.55 million a year earlier, mainly due to a lower contribution from its 18.8%-owned associate Wilmar International Ltd and lower profit from its core business segments. Quarterly revenue dropped by 7.5% to RM1.35 billion from RM1.46 billion, primarily due to the absence of contribution from its Indonesian flour operations, which were divested in September 2023.
After four consecutive quarters of losses, $CAPITALA (5099.MY)$ posted a record-high net profit of RM1.64 billion for the third quarter of 2024, compared to a net loss of RM102.75 million a year ago. This was due to recognizing RM2.27 billion in foreign exchange gains, compared with a forex loss of RM93.92 million in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The significant forex gains were attributed to the weakening of the US dollar against local currencies of the markets where the group operates. Quarterly revenue grew by 16.6% to RM4.93 billion from RM4.23 billion.
$BJCORP (3395.MY)$ posted a net loss of RM167.85 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to a net profit of RM111.08 million a year ago, due to its retail and services businesses. Quarterly revenue decreased by 13.3% to RM2.23 billion from RM2.57 billion.
$SUPERMX (7106.MY)$ extended its streak of losses to seven quarters with a net loss of RM64.6 million in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to a loss of RM2.05 million a year ago. The glovemaker's operating expenses surged by 77%, and the company also booked unrealized foreign exchange losses totaling RM45.6 million. Revenue, however, increased by 26% to RM224.65 million from RM177.96 million due to increased demand. Supermax stated that it is still fulfilling low-priced contracts until the end of 2024 and faces challenges such as emerging competitors in Vietnam due to an acute labor shortage in Malaysia.
$FFB (5306.MY)$ 's net profit more than doubled to RM26.18 million in the second quarter of 2025, from RM12.79 million a year ago, due to decreased dairy raw material costs. Revenue increased by 26% to RM249.16 million from RM198.3 million, attributable to contributions from Sin Wah, higher Horeca and commercial UHT sales, and the positive impact of new product launches. The company declared an interim dividend of one sen per share, payable on December 27.
$CHINTEK (1929.MY)$ announced a special dividend of 7 sen and an interim dividend of 8 sen per share for FY2025, payable on December 27. This follows a total of 40 sen in dividends for FY2024. The company holds a net cash position of RM429.9 million as of August.
$ICON (5255.MY)$, planning to rebrand as Lianson Fleet Group, reported a 3QFY2024 net profit surge to RM19.43 million, up from RM6.21 million, driven by higher daily charter rates despite a drop in utilization. Revenue rose 20.66% to RM70.58 million, with a robust OSV orderbook.
$GTRONIC (7022.MY)$ is collaborating with POET Technologies Inc. on the manufacturing and testing of optical engines for data centers and telecoms. Globetronics will handle assembly, packaging, and testing, while POET provides designs and materials.
$ABMB (2488.MY)$ saw a 2.5% YoY increase in 2QFY2025 net profit to RM189.91 million, attributed to revenue growth. It declared a first interim dividend of 9.50 sen per share, payable on December 30, amidst record high quarterly revenue of RM605.65 million.
Source: Dow Jones Newswires, Bursa Malaysia, The Malaysian Reserve, The Star, The EDGE

title: Malaysian stocks are weak, Galaxy International: It's the perfect time to buy Hershey.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
(Kuala Lumpur, 2nd headline) Recently, the Malaysian stock market has been sluggish, especially after a continuous decline since August. Galaxy International Securities believes that considering the current valuation is still historically low, it is an excellent buying opportunity.
Galaxy International Securities pointed out in its latest report that the recent market performance has been rather flat, but the overall price-to-earnings ratio valuation is expected to expand by 2025.
"Our recommended 20 preferred stocks have a price-to-earnings ratio valuation of 12.8 times for 2025, providing a 18% two-year compound annual growth rate (CAGR) and a 4.1% weekly dividend yield."
Looking back at the Malaysian stock market trend, after experiencing three consecutive years of decline, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI has increased by 15% year-on-year in the first eight months of this year, and the FTSE Bursa Malaysia All Share Index has risen by 16%.
However, in the following three months, the Malaysian stocks have experienced a significant decline. As of the end of November, the composite index's growth rate has narrowed to 10%, while the overall index has increased by 13%.
Analysts believe that despite the 2025 budget continuing to emphasize the continuation of the Changming economic reform and growth agenda, double-digit profit growth, the prospect of a stronger ringgit (despite the volatility caused by the possibility of Trump's second term), as well as accelerating domestic demand and other positive factors, the market performance is still lackluster.
Stock prices have not kept pace with profit growth.
"Although compared to the end of last year, stock prices have risen somewhat, valuation is still at the lower end of historical range, failing to keep up with the pace of profit growth."
As for the recent third-quarter earnings season, analysts believe that the ringgit strengthened significantly from 4.72 at the end of June to 4.13 at the end of September, causing significant changes in the performance of many industries, with the negative impact being more pronounced.
Analysts explain that the negative impact is mainly concentrated on companies with the US dollar as their main source of income and operating overseas.
For companies with a significant amount of costs denominated in US dollars, the positive impact typically lags by 3 to 6 months.
Furthermore, the report also mentions that large-cap companies, due to holding a significant amount of foreign currency debt, recognize some costs early, thereby bringing substantial forex gains.
Looking at the Malaysian stocks, among the 18 industries tracked by Galaxy International Securities, only 5 industries achieved double-digit year-on-year growth in normalized net profit in the third quarter, namely construction building materials, financial services, oil & gas services, industry and technology; the industrial sector has turned from losses to profits.
"Interestingly, the planting industry, especially in Kuala Lumpur ($KLK(2445.MY)$ ) and Sarawak plantation ($SWKPLNT(5135.MY)$ ) and non-essential consumer goods, such as Genting Malaysia ($GENM(4715.MY)$ ), Teck Seng ($DXN(5318.MY)$ ), and Power Root ($PWROOT(7237.MY)$ ), have relatively lagged behind in annual performance expectations.
Analysts pointed out that since the wave of results began, the overall net profit expectations for the next two years have been reduced by 1% each, mainly due to the downward revision of profitability expectations in the petrochemical industry.
同时，还下调了交通运输和非必需消费品领域的预期，但上调了产业和综合领域的预期。
“根据我们的最新数据，今明年的增长预期分别为14%和11%。”

title: Malaysian stock market underperformed in the third quarter, hopes of reaching 1700 shattered.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Malaysian stocks performed poorly in the third quarter, with hopes of breaching 1700 dashed.
$FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index(.KLSE.MY)$
With the overall performance in the third quarter of this year falling short of expectations, coupled with the external headwinds following Trump's victory, the previously optimistic sentiment of Malaysian stocks breaking 1700 points is dissipating.
Several investment banks have successively released third quarter performance summary reports, all indicating that as Malaysian stock profit expectations decline, they have subsequently lowered the FBM KLCI index target to below 1700 points.
Lianchang International Securities previously hoped that the sse conglomerates index could reach a high of 1732 points, but now the target has been reduced to 1635 points. Dahua Jixian and Fenglong Investment Bank also adjusted their termination targets to 1650 points and 1620 points respectively; previously forecasted at 1735 points and 1720 points.
Based on several factors, analysts at Lianchang International Securities slightly view the overall performance of Malaysian stocks in the third quarter with a negative outlook.
"First of all, our earnings adjustment ratio in the third quarter has dropped to 0.7 times, indicating that the number of companies for which we have lowered profit expectations is more than those for which we have raised expectations. In contrast, the earnings adjustment ratios in the first and second quarters of this year were 1.4 times and 1.1 times respectively."
Secondly, the analyst pointed out that exporters have been impacted by the strengthening of the ringgit, resulting in a decline in profits, especially in glove and technology stocks, while consumer stocks have also performed poorly, affected by weak consumer sentiment.
Blue chip stocks have underperformed.
"Another point is that some large constituents of the sse conglomerates index, such as$PCHEM(5183.MY)$ 、$MISC(3816.MY)$ 、$GENTING(3182.MY)$ 、$KLK(2445.MY)$ 、$MRDIY(5296.MY)$ And$NESTLE(4707.MY)$ All delivered lower-than-expected profit performance.
Analysts added that despite the banks' performance exceeding expectations, the third-quarter performance in areas such as gloves, consumer, gambling, and technology fell short of expectations.
Therefore, the analyst has reduced the core net profit growth forecast for the constituent stocks of the sse conglomerates index for the next two years to 12% and 8% respectively.
Deviation from expectations is significant.
Dahua Jianxian analyst also stated that whether the companies surpass or fall short of expectations, there is an increase in the third quarter. However, considering the uncertainties of Trump's trade policies, he decided to lower the sse conglomerates index profit forecasts for 2024 and 2025 by 0.8% and 1.7% respectively.
Currently, we predict that the sse conglomerates index earnings will increase by 10.7% this year, and then by 8.3% next year.
In an unfavorable investment sentiment environment, the analyst has lowered the sse conglomerates index target from 1735 points to 1650 points by the end of this year.
Expecting window dressing.
Regardless, we still expect some window dressing activities by the end of the year. Investors can take advantage of this opportunity, and Malaysian stocks are expected to regain momentum in the first quarter of next year.
He added that the current investment sentiment reflects investors' overly fearful view of Trump's trade policies and potential threats. By the first quarter of next year, investors may start to believe that Trump will actually adopt a more rational trade policy.
In terms of investment themes, the analyst continues to be bullish on Iskandar Malaysia 2.0, datacenter and China's recovery as the top three directions, followed by blockchain, renewable energy, and the electronics and electrical (E&E) sector.
Future themes favored by the Fenglong Investment Bank analysts include the recovery of the tourism industry, energy transformation, further development in Johor, and increased disposable income for the people.
Overall, various investment banks remain optimistic about the Malaysian stock market in 2025. An analyst from AllianceDBS Research pointed out that the increase in domestic liquidity, expected merger and acquisition activities, strength of the ringgit, and robust foreign direct investment (FDI) will drive Malaysian stocks.
Therefore, the analyst has set the year-end target for the sse conglomerates index in 2025 at 1766 points.

title: 99SMART joins the constituent stocks, while both Genting heroes are eliminated.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
99 Speed Mart $99SMART (5326.MY)$ With 99SMART $GAMUDA (5398.MY)$ Living up to expectations, successfully included in the new round of composite index constituent stocks $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ list, while both Genting heroes sadly exit.
According to the latest composite index constituent stock review list announced by FTSE Russell today, 99 Speed Mart and 99SMART will replace Genting $GENTING (3182.MY)$ and Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$ 。
As for the list of candidates, there are a total of 5 companies, namely Malaysian banks $AMBANK (1015.MY)$ Genting, United Plantations $UTDPLT (2089.MY)$ Malaysia Airports $AIRPORT (5014.MY)$ and Westports Holdings $WPRTS (5246.MY)$ 。
The above adjustments will take effect on the 23rd of this month, and the next mid-term review will be scheduled for June 2025.
Qualified through fast entry method.
FTSE Russell will determine the new round of index top 30 constituents based on market capitalization rankings as of November 25, with companies in the top 25 by market cap essentially qualifying.
It is worth noting that 99 Speed Mart is a continuation of IHH Medical Group $IHH (5225.MY)$ Another company has entered the SSE index components through the "Fast Entry" method.
According to the basic rules of the index series, if the market cap of a newly listed company exceeds 2% of the total market cap of the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI, it can enter the SSE index components through "Fast Entry" method. 99 Speed Mart was listed on the main board of the Malaysian stock market on September 9th, meeting the requirements in terms of market cap and trading volume.
In addition, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia Mid 70 Index welcomes 9 new members, in addition to Genting Malaysia and Genting Plantations, there are also Hap Seng, Genting Plantations, Malakoff, NationGate Holdings, Oriental Holdings, and Tanco Holdings. $CARLSBG (2836.MY)$ Genting Plantations $GENP (2291.MY)$ Malakoff $MALAKOF (5264.MY)$ NationGate Holdings $NATGATE (0270.MY)$ Oriental Holdings $ORIENT (4006.MY)$ Tanco Holdings $TANCO (2429.MY)$ And Great institutions $VITROX (0097.MY)$ 。

title: 99Speedmart and Gamuda Set for Further Gains?
author: Moomoo News MY
body:
The FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI constituent review, announced after market close on December 5th, saw the entry of 99Speedmart and Gamuda, marking the first exit for long-standing blue-chip stocks $GENTING (3182.MY)$ and $GENM (4715.MY)$, which had been constituents for 15 years.
This semi-annual adjustment, occurring in June and December each year, evaluates companies based on their market capitalization and liquidity as of November 25th's close. Typically, the top 25 companies by market cap secure their place, with this change becoming effective on December 23rd.
$99SMART (5326.MY)$, the largest IPO in seven years, achieved a remarkable feat by entering the index within three months of its listing, highlighting a significant moment for Malaysian IPOs this year. Its IPO price was set at RM1.65, offering investors a robust return exceeding 52%.
The last company to gain fast entry was $IHH (5225.MY)$, which was included just one month after its listing and currently ranks fifth with a market capitalization of 64.59B.
Additionally, on November 8th, 99Speedmart released its Q3 2024 financial report, highlighting an 8.8% increase in revenue. Lee Thiam Wah, Founder and CEO of 99Speedmart, stated:
“We are pleased to announce a series of strong financial results. Our commitment to expanding our store network remains unwavering. In just the first nine months, we added 177 new stores, bringing our total to 2,697 stores as of September 30, 2024. This marks a significant step toward our goal of achieving 3,000 stores by 2025.”
$GAMUDA (5398.MY)$ also garnered attention, climbing to the 17th position with a year-to-date return of 100%, making it one of the best-performing construction and property development firms. The surge is attributed to lucrative data center construction contracts, with cumulative orders expected to reach RM31.4 billion by year-end, potentially generating RM2.45 billion in pre-tax profits at a 7% margin.
In contrast, $GENTING (3182.MY)$ and $GENM (4715.MY)$ have faced challenges, with both stocks underperforming year-to-date. Despite GENM reporting a 220% surge in net profit for the nine months ending September 2024, optimism about the international tourism sector and regional gaming market recovery remains cautious following a steady decline since its peak in 2017.
Reviewing the changes in constituents over the years, at this time last year, the $YTLPOWR (6742.MY)$ duo was included in the index and subsequently reached new highs in the first half of the year amid the development of data centers. This June, $SUNWAY (5211.MY)$ was announced to replace AMMB Holdings in the index. Sunway now boasts a market capitalization of RM27.48 billion, ranking 15th. Its stock price has steadily risen following its inclusion, benefiting from the booming construction sector due to high-margin government contracts and data center projects this year.
As one of Malaysia's key indices, the FTSE Russell Malaysia Composite Index is also the benchmark for the FTSE Bursa Malaysia Kuala Lumpur Composite Index Futures (FKLI), and is tracked by a related passive fund, $FBMKLCI-EA (0820EA.MY)$. Investors seeking broad exposure to Malaysia’s top 30 blue-chip stocks can opt for this ETF, providing an efficient way to track the overall market performance at a lower cost.
Meanwhile, companies newly included in the FTSE 70 MidCap Index alongside $GENTING (3182.MY)$ and $GENM (4715.MY)$ are $CARLSBG (2836.MY)$, $GENP (2291.MY)$, $MALAKOF (5264.MY)$, $NATGATE (0270.MY)$ , $ORIENT (4006.MY)$, $TANCO (2429.MY)$ , and $VITROX (0097.MY)$.

author: Tynkr Lab
body:
Click Here: TYNKR LAB™
Bursa Malaysia’s $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ slipped by 2.71 points to 1,612.93 during the morning session, reflecting a cautious mood ahead of the U.S. non-farm payrolls report. The index traded within a narrow six-point range of 1,611.25 to 1,617.57 as investors focused on profit-taking in key counters. Regional sentiment was mixed, with political tensions in South Korea and inflation concerns influencing markets.
Sectoral Performance and Key Movements Broad-based selling was observed across multiple sectors. Notable decliners included $NESTLE (4707.MY)$, which dropped RM1 to RM96.62, $LPI (8621.MY)$ falling 34 sen to RM12.64, and $F&N (3689.MY)$ declining 30 sen to RM27.86. Despite the overall softer market, glove stocks gained traction, with $SUPERMX (7106.MY)$ advancing 7.5 sen to RM1.06 and $TOPGLOV (7113.MY)$ rising 2 sen to RM1.27, boosted by potential inclusion in U.S. healthcare payment adjustments.
FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Rebalancing The latest $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ review resulted in significant changes to its constituents. $GENTING (3182.MY)$ and $GENM (4715.MY)$ were removed, replaced by $99SMART (5326.MY)$ and $GAMUDA (5398.MY)$. These changes reflect the evolving dynamics of the Malaysian equity market and will take effect on December 23, 2024. The reserve list now includes $AMBANK (1015.MY)$, $AIRPORT (5014.MY)$, and $UTDPLT (2089.MY)$, among others. Regional and Global Influences Regional markets displayed mixed trends. Japan’s $Nikkei 225 (.N225.JP)$ shed 1.11%, while China’s $SSE Composite Index (000001.SH)$ climbed 1.23%, driven by strong industrial data. In the U.S., the Federal Reserve’s upcoming decision on potential rate cuts kept investors cautious. Asian markets were also influenced by geopolitical uncertainty in South Korea, adding to volatility.
Outlook and Investor Sentiment Bursa Malaysia is expected to consolidate further as investors await clearer economic cues from the U.S. jobs data. While profit-taking activity may continue, interest in sectors such as $Bursa Technology (0005I.MY)$, $Bursa Utilities (0065I.MY)$, and $Bursa Plantation (0025I.MY)$ is anticipated to provide some stability. Key resistance levels for $FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ are projected at 1,620, with support at 1,610.

title: The first half of 2025 will see a turnaround, with Macau casino stocks already falling out of value.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
The first half of 2025 will see a turnaround, with Macau casino stocks already falling out of value.
Multiple factors have led to a massive withdrawal of funds from the domestic gambling industry. However, some market insiders stated that the attractive valuation, profit growth, and rich dividend yield in this field still meet its investment fundamentals. The earliest turnaround is expected to occur in the first half of 2025.
Dahua Xianshan Research's report stated that the gambling industry has experienced a disappointing year, with an average drop of 17.2% in Macau casino stocks' prices, lagging behind the FTSE LonCon Index's growth of 9.6% to date.
"Among them, the underperforming stock is Genting Malaysia.$GENM(4715.MY)$ Genting and Resorts World Genting$GENTING(3182.MY)$ 。”
Due to the poor stock performance of Genting and Resorts World Genting, both have sadly been knocked out of the latest round of index constituents list.
According to the FTSE Russell market capitalization rankings as of November 25, Genting Malaysia and Resorts World Genting ranked 34th and 38th in market capitalization with 12.1 billion ringgit and 14.6 billion ringgit respectively, failing to maintain their status as index constituents.
It is worth noting that the stock performance of Genting Malaysia in recent years, under the influence of several significant events, has significantly declined from its peak of 6 ringgit in 2017 to around 2.16 ringgit now.
The events include the 2018 Century Fox theme park plan changes, the 2019 budget's gambling tax increase, the controversial acquisition of the American Empire Resort, the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, and the recent changes in the SSE conglomerates index components.
Resumption of climbing is expected.
However, analysts pointed out that the above unfavorable factors have been largely reflected in the stock price, and there is limited further downside potential. They also mentioned that as Genting Malaysia's profits stabilize between 2025 and 2026, the market's negative sentiment will gradually reverse.
Analysts believe that although the industry currently lags behind the broader market, its profit growth prospects, undervalued financial metrics, and generous dividend yield are still in line with its investment thesis.
Driven by a surge in foreign tourists and strong domestic consumption, it is estimated that the gambling industry will achieve strong profit performance from the end of 2024 to the first half of 2025.
With the boost from profit performance, Genting's two giants are expected to regain momentum in the first half of 2025, but the recovery momentum will not be too significant.
Genting holds TauRx dark horse.
Analysts also highlighted that TauRx, a UK pharmaceutical company in which Genting holds a 20.33% stake, is a potential dark horse. This is due to its convincing clinical trial results for drugs targeting Alzheimer's (commonly known as dementia), currently in discussions with regulatory authorities in the UK and the USA to facilitate product approval and commercialization.
However, the approval and commercialization process may be lengthy, and the current timeline remains uncertain.
TauRx's potential valuation reaches as high as 15 billion USD, calculated based on Genting's ownership proportion, equivalent to a value of 3.54 ringgit per share, representing over 73% of its current market cap.
In conclusion, the investment advantage of Genting and Galaxy lies in their defensive characteristics, as well as the rich weekly dividend yield support. With the stabilization of revenue and cash flow in the gambling industry, the weekly dividend yield is expected to rise to 5.1% and return to the pre-epidemic level of 9%.
The gambling industry is waiting for favorable winds.
As for the gaming business, although operators still face challenges from illegal operators, the business has basically returned to pre-epidemic levels.
If the market's negative sentiment improves, there will be more gambling opportunities.$SPTOTO(1562.MY)$ Both Genting and Galaxy are expected to regain investor favor.$MAGNUM(3859.MY)$ Looking ahead to a potential return of investor favor.
Over the past four years, both Genting and Galaxy have been heavily impacted by the epidemic and political uncertainties, but their current valuations already fully reflect these unfavorable factors, and profits are gradually returning to the right track.
On the other hand, RGB International, a supplier of casino slot machines.$RGB(0037.MY)$ Also expected to catch the industry tailwind.
"Because the company is in a favorable position, it can leverage the thriving gambling industry in Southeast Asia to achieve exponential growth, directly benefiting from the trend."
Overall, Dah Sing Securities maintains a "shareholding" rating for the gambling industry and predicts that the sector will outperform the SSE conglomerates index in the first half of 2025 with the help of domestic and external catalysts.

raw.feed_title: The first half of 2025 will see a turnaround, with Macau casino stocks already falling out of value.

rich_text.text: The first half of 2025 will see a turnaround, with Macau casino stocks already falling out of value.

Multiple factors have led to a massive withdrawal of funds from the domestic gambling industry. However, some market insiders stated that the attractive valuation, profit growth, and rich dividend yield in this field still meet its investment fundamentals. The earliest turnaround is expected to occur in the first half of 2025.

Dahua Xianshan Research's report stated that the gambling industry has experienced a disappointing year, with an average drop of 17.2% in Macau casino stocks' prices, lagging behind the FTSE LonCon Index's growth of 9.6% to date.
"Among them, the underperforming stock is Genting Malaysia.
Due to the poor stock performance of Genting and Resorts World Genting, both have sadly been knocked out of the latest round of index constituents list.

According to the FTSE Russell market capitalization rankings as of November 25, Genting Malaysia and Resorts World Genting ranked 34th and 38th in market capitalization with 12.1 billion ringgit and 14.6 billion ringgit respectively, failing to maintain their status as index constituents.

It is worth noting that the stock performance of Genting Malaysia in recent years, under the influence of several significant events, has significantly declined from its peak of 6 ringgit in 2017 to around 2.16 ringgit now.

The events include the 2018 Century Fox theme park plan changes, the 2019 budget's gambling tax increase, the controversial acquisition of the American Empire Resort, the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, and the recent changes in the SSE conglomerates index components.

author: Moomoo News MY
body:
Good morning mooers! Here are things you need to know about today's market:
Tesla's stock soared by 7.36% to $462.28 on Christmas Eve.
Market activity and trading volume decreased, while the Malaysian stock market also experienced a slight increase.
Stocks to watch: COASTAL, GENTING, GENM
- Moomoo News MY
Wall Street Summary
$S&P 500 Index (.SPX.US)$ 6040.04(+1.10%)
$Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI.US)$ 43297.03(+0.91%)
$Nasdaq Composite Index (.IXIC.US)$ 20031.13(+1.35%)
Stocks closed higher on Tuesday in a quiet session that ended early due to the Christmas Eve holiday. Despite low trading volumes, all three of Wall Street's main indices managed to gain around 1%. $Tesla (TSLA.US)$ rose by 7.36% to $462.28. Markets also closed all day on Wednesday for Christmas Day.
Bursa Market Insight
$FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI Index (.KLSE.MY)$ 1602.99 (+0.43%)
Top Gainer: $YTLPOWR (6742.MY)$ RM4.19 (+1.95%)
Top Loser: $HLBANK (5819.MY)$ RM20.20 (-0.69%)
Year-end window-dressing by institutional investors boosted the rally on Tuesday, but market activity was low with only 2.01 billion shares traded as many took a holiday break ahead of Christmas. Bursa Malaysia was closed yesterday for the holiday.
IPO Scanner
Stocks to Watch
Coastal Contracts Bhd $COASTAL (5071.MY)$ is diversifying into the renewable-energy sector with a maiden solar project, as reported by RHB Research, which maintains a "buy" recommendation with a target price of RM1.67. The company, along with subsidiaries and a consortium partner, received an offer acceptance from the Energy Commission of Sabah to develop a 15MWac solar plant, with Coastal Contracts holding a 95% stake. The project, expected to commence operations by mid-2027, is estimated to generate annual earnings of RM2-3 million and an IRR of 10-12%. This strategic move is seen as a positive step towards reducing reliance on traditional income sources and aligning with the government's green energy initiatives.
Genting's $GENTING (3182.MY)$ earnings momentum is set to gain from Chinese tourist rebound and potential US and Thai casino licenses. Philip Capital Research, maintaining an "overweight" stance, anticipates a significant earnings boost, especially if Genting secures a New York casino license, which could add RM250mil to RM320mil to Ebitda in 2026. The research house values Genting's stock between RM1.06 and RM2.64 per share, considering its 20% stake in TauRx Pharmaceuticals Ltd's dementia drug development. With Genting expected to show 24% earnings growth and Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$ 18% in 2025, the focus is on Genting's multifaceted growth and valuation, trading at 5.5 times enterprise value to Ebitda.
Source: Dow Jones Newswires, Bursa Malaysia, The Malaysian Reserve, The Star, The EDGE

title: Financially undervalued, attractive dividend yield, Macau Casino stocks expected to rebound in the first half.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
(Kuala Lumpur, 3rd News) Analysts pointed out that the stock performance of Macau Casino companies lagged behind the FTSE Bursa Composite Index last year, but they believe it will gradually rebound in the first half of 2025.
Dahua Jixian stated, "We believe that the industry's profit growth, undervalued financial indicators, and attractive weekly dividend yield align very well with our potential lagging investment strategy."
"We expect profits to strengthen quarter by quarter from the fourth quarter of the 2024 fiscal year (4Q24) to the first half of 2025, mainly due to a large influx of international tourists and a strong domestic consumption trend."
This will lead to a gradual recovery in the industry's stock price in the first half of this year, but the momentum will be moderate.
According to data from the research institution, the trend of tourism consumption is still in a growth range, with consumer spending in the third quarter of 2024 increasing by 4.9% year-on-year.
Our channel survey shows that the business volume of the casino and NFO sectors remained strong between October and November 2024.
In the gambling sector, various related indicators such as flight capacity and international tourist visitation have all increased month-on-month. As for NFO, lottery sales have already recovered and stabilized at over 90% of pre-epidemic levels.
The report points out that the current valuation of the gambling industry is 1.5 to 2 standard deviations below the average level, making it highly attractive as it is still in the early stages post-epidemic.
Additionally, this industry still offers a generous weekly dividend yield ranging from 5.1% to 10.5%, benefiting from stable income and cash flow between 2024 and 2025, significantly improving compared to the low base during the epidemic.
Analysts expect that Resorts World Genting$GENTING (3182.MY)$ and Resorts World Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$ will show improvement quarter-on-quarter in the fourth quarter of 2024, with total gambling revenue (GGR) of Resorts World Genting recovering to approximately 100% of the 2019 level.
In the third quarter of 2024, its GGR had already reached 90%.
In addition, Resorts World Genting in Malaysia has a good chance of obtaining a full casino license in southern New York, which could increase pre-tax and depreciation earnings (EBITDA) by 0.106 billion US dollars (approximately 0.47 billion Ringgit).
The investment return for TauRx is still uncertain.
As for Genting's investment in TauRx Pharmaceuticals, it remains an uncertain factor.
Genting initially invested 0.1118 billion US dollars (approximately 0.5 billion Ringgit) to acquire a 20% stake in TauRx Pharmaceuticals, and increased the investment to 0.12 billion US dollars (approximately 0.534 billion Ringgit) in 2016.
In March 2024, TauRx reported convincing 24-month Phase III clinical trial data for HMTM, a drug for Alzheimer's disease.
"Although the group has initiated regulatory processes for product approval and commercialization in the United Kingdom and the United States, we recognize that the approval and commercialization process for HMTM may take a longer time and the timeline is unclear.
"That being said, TauRx's potential valuation reaches 15 billion US dollars (approximately 66.75 billion Ringgit), which could translate to about 3.54 Ringgit per share for Genting's 20.3% stake, representing over 94% of the current market value."
Source: Nanyang Siang Pau

title: Is there any sign of the eagerly awaited tourism recovery, will Genting Singapore and Malaysia turn the tide?
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Is there a glimpse of hope for the long-awaited tourism recovery, will Genting Sing and Malaysia see a turn for the better?
The number of Chinese tourists is recovering strongly and is now very close to pre-pandemic levels. This optimistic trend is benefiting both Genting Sing and Malaysia, both of whose businesses are experiencing a strong rebound this year.$GENTING(3182.MY)$ Due to the lackluster tourist recovery and various negative news, both Genting Sing and Malaysia's businesses are witnessing a strong rebound this year.
Amidst the less-than-ideal tourist recovery and multiple negative news, Genting Malaysia$GENM(4715.MY)$ Genting Sing$Genting Sing(G13.SG)$ The stock prices of Genting and its parent company Genting did not perform well last year, with Genting Singapore, which is listed locally, being delisted from the FTSE Conglomerates Index; while Genting Sing fell by 20% for the whole of last year.
On the other hand, after communicating with Genting Malaysia, Lion Capital International Securities learned that during the peak festive season at the end of last year, the number of Chinese tourists had significantly increased; and some casinos in Genting World reopened, coinciding with this period.
As for the business aspect in neighboring Singapore, Bloomberg Intelligence pointed out that, judging from the explosive growth in the number of flights, Genting Sing's revenue last year is expected to surpass pre-pandemic levels, reaching 102% of 2019!
Data shows that the number of tourists in Singapore for the first 11 months of 2024 increased by 22% compared to the same period last year, reaching 87% of the pre-pandemic level.
Due to a significant increase in Chinese arrivals, the total number of tourists for the year is expected to reach the upper limit of the Singapore government's target of 15 million to 16.5 million visits.
"The number of Chinese tourists alone has increased by 1.34 times year-on-year in the first 11 months."
Especially with competitors like Marina Bay Sands Hotel already fully booked, Bloomberg Intelligence is further convinced that the continuous influx of tourists will benefit Genting Sing.
Analysts also indicate that as promotional activities return to normal, it is expected that Genting Sing's profit margin in 2025 will be close to the level in 2023, further driving profit recovery.
"This indicates the gradual improvement in Genting Sing's operational efficiency and profitability, laying a solid foundation for future development."
Visa-free policies boost
Increased attractiveness of Genting Malaysia
Regarding Genting Malaysia, Lianchang International analysts also believe that the company is actively leveraging multiple bullish factors to attract tourists, especially high-spending Chinese visitors, laying the groundwork for future development.
"The extension of visa-free entry for Chinese tourists until 2026, the increase in flights between the two locations, and the upcoming 2026 Tourism Year, are all factors that enhance Genting World's appeal to Chinese visitors."
As it enters 2025, coinciding with Genting World's 60th anniversary, the company will deploy more activities and promotions to attract more visitors, further solidifying its position as a tourist hotspot.
The report points out that this series of Global Strategy indicates that Genting Malaysia is riding the market trend and policy dividends, helping to drive business growth and inject new momentum into its development.
Analysts further stated that Genting Malaysia has reopened most of the casino areas in Genting World, and has integrated digital technology, including the introduction of Electronic Table Games (ETG) and small bets, which can attract young visitors and effectively control labor costs.
With the upcoming Lunar New Year, this strategy will support first-quarter operations in 2025, achieving cost optimization during operations.
Given the recovery in tourism and the growth prospects of Genting World, analysts maintain a 'Shareholding' rating with a target price of 3.65 Ringgit.
Source: Nanyang Siang Pau

title: [Exclusive/Nanyang Rich List] Hsieh Fu-nian's wealth doubles · Lee Liang-hua enters the top ten, Yang Su-bin strongly climbs to the top three.
author: 南洋商报 NYSP
body:
Exclusive report: Lin Zhibin
After a year of hard work and effort, those billionaires standing at the top of the business wave have delivered an impressive answer sheet. Under the wave of Datacenter in Malaysia, institutions in the Technology and construction sectors focusing on this field have repeatedly proven their influence with strength.
Among them, Yang Zhongli, who first seized the AI wave in our country, saw their stock prices soar for two consecutive years; this has caused the group's leader, Tan Sri Yang Subin, and family wealth to increase annually, placing them in the top three of the Malaysian billionaire list.
As of the end of 2024, Yang Subin and his family's wealth has surged by 7 billion Ringgit compared to the previous year, reaching 21.5 billion Ringgit. His position on the billionaire list has thus improved from 5th place a year ago to 3rd place.
Moreover, the Yang family is now not far from the top two billionaires in our country. This is mainly because our country's perennial richest man, Guo Heniang, and Tan Sri Guan Baoqiang, who has ranked second on the billionaire list for four consecutive years, have both experienced a shrinkage in wealth over the past year.
However, Yang Subin seems to be starting the year poorly in 2025. With the USA implementing restrictions on AI Chip and the free coupon red envelopes not being well-received by the market, within less than a month into the year, the Yang brothers have already faced two waves of drastic declines. It remains uncertain whether the Yang family can continue to turn risks into opportunities and shine again in 2025.
Besides the Yang family making a strong entry into the top three, the 2024 Nanyang Rich List also witnessed the emergence of Sunway. $SUNWAY (5211.MY)$ Founder and Group Chairman Tan Sri Cheah Fook Ling saw his wealth surge by over 10 billion Ringgit within a year. $99SMART (5326.MY)$ After its listing, the founder Li Liang Hua of 99 Speed Mart revealed his wealth, making a strong entrance into Malaysia's top ten richest list with a net worth of 17.6 billion Ringgit.
The wealth of Malaysia's top 40 tycoons surged by 45.9 billion Ringgit, challenging Robert Kuok's position as the richest man.
The year 2024 is a good year for Malaysian stocks. After experiencing three years of decline, the Malaysian stocks finally flourished in the Year of the Dragon, with the FTSE Bursa Malaysia Conglomerates Index rising nearly 13% throughout the year. In such favorable conditions, Malaysia's billionaires naturally seized the opportunity, with the total wealth of the top 40 billionaires increasing by 45.9 billion Ringgit or 19.3%, reaching a total of 306.9 billion Ringgit.
Among them, without a doubt, once again reigning as Malaysia's richest person is the 'Sugar King' Robert Kuok. However, over the past year, as his assets across Malaysia, Singapore, and Hong Kong have shrunk, Robert Kuok's wealth has decreased by over 2.5 billion Ringgit, falling below 30 billion Ringgit, with a 'remaining' fortune of 28.57 billion Ringgit.
Compared to Robert Kuok's peak wealth, this now represents almost a halving! In 2017, his net worth soared to 49.9 billion Ringgit, but in recent years, due to the devastation of the pandemic and a decline in the Chinese consumer market where he focuses, the Sugar King's wealth fell to 31.1 billion Ringgit last year and has further declined this year.
That being said, Robert Kuok has still maintained the title of richest person for many years, primarily because of Qi Li, who ranks second on China's billionaire list. $PMETAL (8869.MY)$ The total wealth of CEO Tan Sri Kuan Bo Chiang and his family also saw a decline last year.
The two top tycoons of the billionaire list encountered a setback.
In 2024, Qi Li's performance was actually not too bad. Global aluminum prices and Qi Li's performance both increased, but unfortunately, the stock price performance was not particularly outstanding, with a yearly increase of 1.9%, which is quite unsatisfactory compared to the overall market.
For the Kuan family, the main culprit for their wealth not increasing but instead declining is their other aluminum products manufacturer, Qi Li Technology. $PMBTECH (7172.MY)$ Due to significant fluctuations in performance and being overvalued, Qi Li Technology's stock plummeted by 35% last year.
This consequently led to the Kuan family's wealth being recorded at 23.59 billion Ringgit, a slight decline of 0.06 billion Ringgit or 0.3%, allowing them to maintain the second position on the billionaire list.
在管保强与家族之后，杨忠礼机构 $YTL (4677.MY)$ 的掌门人丹斯里杨肃斌与家族的财富正在高速增长，如今以21.5 billion令吉的身家坐上了2024南洋富豪榜探花的位置，对前两名发起了强烈的
群雄争霸
与此同时，富豪榜的大黑马，分别执掌IOI集团 $IOICORP (1961.MY)$与IOI置业 $IOIPG (5249.MY)$ 的拿督李耀祖和李耀昇在经过多年的稳健爬升之后，财富突破了20 billion令吉，以20.3 billion令吉身家，位居我国第4富豪的位置。
追溯历史，在李耀祖和李耀昇兄弟接掌之前，IOI集团的创办人，已故丹斯里李深静，曾在2017年身家突破20 billion令吉；但在李深静逝世之后，IOI集团陷入了短暂的悲痛与动荡当中。如今，李氏兄弟的身家重新返回20 billion令吉以上，完美地证明了虎父无犬子。
In 2024, there are a total of 4 billionaires in the country with a net worth exceeding 20 billion Ringgit, but in the new year, the competition at the top of the billionaire list is not limited to these 4 individuals, as the 5th ranked billionaire, from Sunway, $SUNWAY (5211.MY)$ Tan Sri Cheah Fook Nien, is only a whisker away from the top ranks.
Cheah Fook Nien's total net worth reaches 19.96 billion Ringgit in 2024, just a step away from the 20 billion threshold! Don't forget, Sunway's Medical business may go public within the next couple of years, at which point, it is believed he will bring a new impact to our country's billionaire list!
The new waves push the old waves.
In contrast, the 6th place in the billionaire list, the late Tan Sri Cheng Hong Biao, although his wealth is also infinitely close to the 20 billion threshold at 19.72 billion Ringgit, with the Cheng family having clarified the method of inheritance distribution, including gradually reducing their shareholding in Public Bank $PBBANK (1295.MY)$ to below 10%, it is expected that Cheng Hong Biao and his descendants will gradually lose competitiveness in the future Nanyang billionaire list, and the situation of once being ranked second in the Malaysian billionaire list can only become a memory.
However, the billionaire list is often like this, the old waves have not yet receded, the new waves have already rushed in. Following Cheng Hong Biao, ranked 7th in the 2024 Nanyang billionaire list, is last year's brightest new wave, the founder and CEO of 99 Speed Mart, Li Lianghua.
After 99 Speed Mart went public last September, the stock price has been soaring, and within just three months it made its way into the Blue Chip category. This propelled Li Lianghua to land at 7th place on the billionaire list with a net worth of 17.6 billion Ringgit.
Lin Guotai has dropped out of the top ten.
In the 2024 Nanyang Rich List, besides Li Lianghua who parachuted in at the 7th position, the changes in the top ten richest individuals in our country are minimal. At the 8th position is Datuk Seri Dr. Khoo Kay Peng, the founder of Hong Leong Group, whose wealth has increased, but due to stronger performances by other billionaires, his ranking has dropped by 2 places.
As for the 9th-ranked Xie Songkun and his family, as well as the 10th-ranked late Ananda Krishnan, their wealth changes in 2024 are not substantial, and they have maintained their positions among the top ten richest in our country.
As for the one who was "kicked out" of the top ten billionaires by Li Lianghua, it is Datuk Lim Goh Tong from Genting Group. Over the past few years, Genting's businesses around the world seem to have faced continuous setbacks, with the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic still lingering on the global tourism industry, which has not fully recovered, and after years of decline, the once Malaysian Star Stock Genting $GENTING (3182.MY)$ and Resorts World Genting Malaysia $GENM (4715.MY)$ , has now been removed from the FTSE Bursa Malaysia Conglomerates Index.
Consequently, Lim Kuo Tai's wealth has also repeatedly decreased. After losing 1.25 billion Ringgit last year, his net worth is now less than 8 billion Ringgit, ranking him 14th.
In addition to Lim Kuo Tai, there are several other notable figures outside the top ten, who have previously made headlines in the Nanyang Wealth Rankings. For example, Asia's Mercedes tycoon Tan Sri Lau Chu Kuan has a fate very similar to Lim Kuo Tai in the wealth rankings. $HAPSENG (3034.MY)$ The company he leads, Synthesia, has been expelled from the Blue Chip ranks after continuous stock price declines; his position on the wealth list has also slipped to 17th.
Former top wealth holders sharing the same fate.
Also experiencing a continued decline is the late Cambodian gambling king, Tan Sri Cheng Lek. Cheng Lek once ranked second in the Nanyang Wealth list, but after his death in 2023, disputes over inheritance arose among his descendants, which significantly reduced his wealth, currently placing him 18th with approximately 5.2 billion Ringgit.
Outside the top ten, there is another former runner-up in the Malaysian wealth rankings, He Te Jia. $HARTA (5168.MY)$ Executive Chairman Kwan Kim An. However, this former second richest person in Malaysia, unlike Lim Kuo Tai and Cheng Lek, has passed the low point and is seeing a recovery in wealth.
The glove tycoon enjoys a sweet return after the hardships.
Actually, it is not just Guan Jin'an; in the past year, the glove tycoons in the country finally reaped the rewards of their hard work. Since the pandemic, glove stocks have experienced both peak periods of immense prosperity and low valleys of being scorned. Fortunately, in 2024, most glove manufacturers have turned losses into profits, causing stock prices to rise significantly, and the net worth of glove tycoons has also seen a substantial increase.
As a result, Guan Jin'an's wealth increased by 46% last year, reaching 6.7 billion Ringgit, ranking 13th and launching a renewed bid for the top 10; while Top Glove's $TOPGLOV (7113.MY)$ Tan Sri Lim Wee Chai, from High Productivity Latex Products, $KOSSAN (7153.MY)$ as well as the brothers from the Singapore-listed glove company Riverstone, Huang Deshun, all saw their fortunes rise by over 40% last year.
Struggle for Supremacy
In 2024, outside the top 20 rankings of the Nanyang Rich List, as usual, it is a fierce competition, with little wealth disparity among the major tycoons. A slight shift in the market sentiment in related fields could significantly impact the rankings of the rich list.
For example, our Technology stocks experienced a rocky journey last year. In general, the performance of Technology stocks in the past year has not been ideal, leading to a notable decline in the wealth of several tech tycoons, and consequently, their rankings also dropped significantly.
The ranking of tech tycoons has significantly fallen.
Among these, the biggest drop belongs to the leaders of Di & Hong and Wu Nanhua and his family. $D&O (7204.MY)$With the global car market cooling down, Di & Hong, which mainly produces automotive semiconductors, could not escape the downturn. The stock price fell by 42% over the year, resulting in a reduction of 0.54 billion Ringgit in Wu Nanhua and his family's wealth last year.
Meanwhile, UWC's executive director and group CEO, Datuk Huang Chai Rong, along with executive director Liu Jiqiang, are also facing similar difficulties. $UWC (5292.MY)$ The company's stock price dropped by more than 10% last year, leading to a shrinkage of 0.26 billion Ringgit in the wealth of the two founders.
This has made the above two groups some of the richest individuals experiencing the most significant drop in the 2024 Nanyang Rich List. Wu Nanhua's ranking fell 9 places to 32nd, with wealth of 2.72 billion Ringgit; Huang Chai Rong and Liu Jiqiang also dropped 9 places to 36th, with wealth of 2.31 billion Ringgit.
Another tech tycoon who has emerged in recent years, Datuk Chen Rongqi, CEO of Ge Dais Technology, shares a similar fate. $GREATEC (0208.MY)$ Last year, his wealth shrank by 0.34 billion Ringgit, and he dropped 7 places in the wealthy list, ranking 27th with a wealth of 3.37 billion Ringgit.
Of course, not every technology stock and tech tycoon has gone through a bitter year; some tech stocks performed well last year due to their business related to the booming datacenters in recent years.
For example, the newcomer king of the 2023 rich list, NationGate Holdings. $NATGATE (0270.MY)$ Executive Director Huang Yongliang has become more and more courageous in his second year on the list, with wealth increasing by over 1 billion Ringgit, now having a fortune of 3.27 billion Ringgit, rising to the 28th position on the rich list.
Three property tycoons have re-entered the list.
On the other hand, over the past year, the construction and property stocks in the country have revived, with Kerjaya being the most typical representative. $KERJAYA (7161.MY)$Datuk Seri Zheng Ronghe has seen his wealth increase by 67% in the past year, and his ranking has climbed to the 23rd position.
At the same time, three billionaires who previously made the Nanyang rich list but whose property stocks performed poorly in recent years, including Datuk Seri Chen Runchuan of Dengkang Holdings. $TANCO (2429.MY)$ Datuk Liang Guohua of Green Prosperity. $ECOWLD (8206.MY)$ and Qiaofeng Holdings. $OSK (5053.MY)$Tan Sri Huang Zonghua has successfully returned to the list of the top 40 billionaires.
The 40th richest person in our country in 2024 is MyEG. $MYEG (0138.MY)$ The Managing Director, Huang Tian Shun, has a wealth of 2.21 billion Ringgit, significantly raising the entry threshold for the Nanyang Rich List by over 30%. In 2023, the entry threshold for the Nanyang Rich List was only 1.69 billion Ringgit.
